title: Evangeline: A Tale of Acadie
author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow
description: "Evangeline: A Tale of Acadie" by Henry Wadsworth Longfellow is an epic poem published in 1847.
longDescription: It follows Evangeline Bellefontaine, an Acadian girl separated from her beloved Gabriel during the British expulsion of Acadians from Nova Scotia.

authorInfo.bio: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow (1807–1882) wrote Evangeline: A Tale of Acadie. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
